text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho, a decisive battle held
among the
shrines and temples of Kyoto,
is about to begin.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite never having raced 3,000
meters before,
Matikanefukukitaru
approaches the track with a
positive
attitude.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Leaving everything to fate and the gods,
she
takes on the hellishly long race!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
